verdict_rationale: Across the entire P90-armed NQ population (6,559 regimes, 586,897 checkpoints), causally observable 5-second price-action (stagnation duration, giveback from extreme) and Model-C dynamics (score drawdown, cooling) FAIL to separate dangerous trend continuation from the +1.00/-0.75 ATR winning reversal zone. Specifically: (1) Baseline expectancy across all P90 checkpoints is -0.0082 ATR (42.39% win rate); (2) Price failure states (e.g. stagnation >=30s and giveback >=0.20 ATR) produce essentially identical negative economics (-0.0114 ATR, 42.20% win rate); (3) Adding Model-C score cooling yields -0.0102 ATR (42.28% win rate), failing to achieve the 42.86% breakeven requirement; (4) In event-study trajectories, Model-C score cooling lags rather than leads the start of winning runs, while price stagnation and minor givebacks occur routinely throughout continuation trends; (5) A chronological OOS diagnostic classifier achieves an ROC-AUC of only 0.528 (essentially random) with top-decile expectancy of -0.0390 ATR. Therefore, ordinary 5-second price and model state information cannot localize reversal execution, conclusively justifying the transition to high-frequency / MBP-1 order-flow absorption research.

best_combination_state.name: Combo 3: Stagnation (>=30s) + Giveback (>=0.20 ATR) + Score Cooling (dd>=0.02)

answers_to_core_questions.2_lead_variables_before_T0: None provide actionable lead separation; Model-C cooling lags T0, while price giveback/stagnation occurs routinely during trend pauses
answers_to_core_questions.3_primary_association: Reversal zones occur after local exhaustion climaxes (T-5s), but cannot be discriminated from continuation pauses with 5s price/model features
answers_to_core_questions.7_does_localization_improve_economics: NO: Gross expectancy remains negative across all states (-0.008 ATR baseline vs -0.011 ATR in Combo 1)
answers_to_core_questions.9_research_justification: Concludes D (transition unobservable with 5s price/model inputs) and strongly justifies C: Moving to MBP-1 / tick-level order-flow absorption research
